The DB Alloy Lage Edition allows for the use of the Lage semi-automatic upper receivers in the DB9 Alloy. Some variation is in place from the original DB9 Alloy. Specifically, the following differences exist:
1. The side plates are different to contour the Lage upper. You will need to order new side plates via sendcutsend or another provider.
2. The lower receivers have the front bottom rail removed. 
3. The rear insert has been modified to slot into the lage upper
4. The front insert has had the bottom rail removed. 
5. The Glock feed ramp has been modified to slot into the Lage upper. If you are using a metal feed ramp you will need to file the sides of the ramp until it fits in the upper. 

Hardware kits available at dbdesignworks.com
